Den som melder høyest, blir spillfører,: The highest bidder chooses trumps and calls a trump card not in their own hand – usually the ace. Whoever holds it becomes the partner and must play it in the first trick. The bidder leads a trump.
Følg farge hvis du kan, ellers legg hva: Follow suit if you can, otherwise play anything. The highest trump wins the trick, else the highest card of the suit led. The winner leads next.
